_readme: The recorded layer of the product hub dashboard. A person changes it through the page's Save button and commits it; the refresh embeds it verbatim and never edits it. focus.items rows are {id, status: open|done, closedAt: ISO time or null, closedNote} and nothing else - titles and evidence live in the page's FOCUS array, keyed by the same id. decisions are {id, subject, question, options: [{id, label, body}], choice: option id or null, decidedAt, note}; a decision's prose stays frozen once recorded. syncLog is a list of {at, kind} entries the page appends.
